notes:
1 Sign Up pehle — apna saara data daalo, wo online store me save hoga; phir wahi number aur Employee ID se Login hoga. Number ya ID database me na mile to login nahi hoga.
2 Forgot ID? — apna number daalo, wo seedha WhatsApp par admin ko chala jayega taake wo aapki Employee ID bata sakein.
3 TL Login ab Gmail aur Password se — PIN lock khatam; access admin dega.
4 Portal se SLIPS card hata diya — baad me dobara add hoga.
5 Sync Now — internet par ek tap me saara data online sync hoga, percentage aur MB ke saath; aakhir me "Synced Now".
6 Premium Request — aapki sign-up wali saari detail WhatsApp par admin ko send hogi, phir access milega.
7 Share Attendance wala purana popup hata diya.
8 Home: Welcome card ab TOM wale neele rang me, aur upar wala TOM Data banner Welcome wale purple rang me.
